capabilities: Generate a title for the current note via a local LLM
Batch-rename notes whose filenames match a timestamp pattern
Rename through fileManager.renameFile so backlinks update
Customize the system prompt, timestamp regex, and scan folders
disambiguation: Not a general AI writing assistant; it only generates titles and renames files.
extras: Desktop only, since mobile cannot reach a desktop's local LLM server. All traffic stays local; the README includes a detailed privacy and permissions section. Installation is developer-style (copying main.js and manifest.json manually). UI is localized in English and Chinese.
problem: Notes saved with timestamp filenames or untitled content stay hard to identify, and Obsidian offers no way to generate and apply titles automatically.

relations.evidence: default LMStudio, works with any OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, vLLM, …)
Other OpenAI-compat servers (Ollama, vLLM, …): just change the Base URL in settings.

requires.name: a local OpenAI-compatible LLM server such as LM Studio, Ollama, or vLLM

summary: Generates note titles with a local LLM server (LM Studio default), renaming the current note or batch-renaming timestamp-pattern notes.
